items.summary: Long-time self-hoster Jan-Lukas Else on how AI revived the hobby: with all infra config (Docker Compose, NixOS, scripts) in Git, a coding agent can work on infrastructure like any software project — NixOS and a custom Debian bootc image that once felt like too much effort took half a day to set up. Renovate opens update PRs you merge from your phone, and GitHub or Forgejo Actions build and deploy on merge; small one-off tools (invoice and e-paper downloaders) get written in Go by the agent on demand. Caveat included: more services mean more maintenance, and you still have to understand what the agent changed.
items.title: AI made self-hosting fun again: infra in Git, a coding agent as sysadmin, Renovate + CI auto-deploy (Hacker News front page, Nov 26, 1,030 points)

items.summary: A desktop AI coding agent built around staying in control: three autonomy levels (Safe, Balanced, Independent) and four modes (Plan, Build, Debug, Review) — the agent proposes changes and nothing happens without your approval unless you allow it. Scan a QR code to drive it from your phone over the local network and approve actions away from your desk. Bring your own model: Claude, GPT, or anything on OpenRouter, with keys stored on-device under OS-level encryption. Also includes a signature log of what the agent actually did, a daily spend dashboard, MCP servers and skills, git worktrees, scheduled jobs, and project memory.
items.title: SADEEM: a desktop coding agent with dial-in autonomy — phone remote control, bring your own model (Product Hunt, Nov 22)

items.summary: A single bash script (no Docker, no sudo, no system packages) that installs and runs llama.cpp, vLLM or Ollama on Linux: before a model starts it checks GPU fit and verifies every file against Hugging Face scans and SHA-256 checksums, and engines run in a sandbox. Each model gets its own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with one gateway address for all models and on-demand start/stop when idle. Optional Open WebUI team chat with hybrid RAG document search, private SearXNG web search, and an in-sandbox terminal for models, plus skills for AI agents. Linux x86-64/ARM64.
items.title: llmserver: one bash script runs a local LLM server — models security-checked, engines sandboxed, with a gateway and web chat (new release Nov 25, Apache-2.0)
